description: Create a sales order (VA01 equivalent) from a customer order (mail/PDF). Resolves the customer (sold_to or customer_name) and every item's material (material number or description) — anything ambiguous or missing is returned as a question for a human INSTEAD of creating the order; also refuses a second order with the same customer PO number. Sales area and order type come from the connection defaults. WRITES — permission gate + write log; dry run unless the connection is live.

dry_run.description: true = build and log the request but send nothing. Writes are ALWAYS dry runs while the tenant's SAP connection has write_mode "dry_run" (the default).

items.description: Order items: material (number or description), quantity, unit

description.description: Material description, used to resolve the material when its number is unknown

purchase_order_by_customer.description: The customer's PO number; a second order with the same number is refused

name: create_sap_sales_order
